description: This file is the minified source code of the Slick carousel plugin, a JavaScript library for creating responsive, customizable carousels/sliders. It includes class definitions, methods for slide management, responsiveness, and user interaction handling.

classes.name: Slick
classes.description: Main class representing the carousel instance, with methods for initialization, slide control, responsiveness, and event handling.

methods.name: activateADA
methods.description: Enables accessibility features by setting ARIA attributes on active slides.

methods.name: addSlide
methods.description: Adds a new slide or slides to the carousel at a specified position.

methods.name: animateHeight
methods.description: Animates the height of the carousel container based on the current slide's height.

methods.name: animateSlide
methods.description: Performs animated transition to a target slide position.

methods.name: getNavTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the target element for navigation if 'asNavFor' option is set.

methods.name: asNavFor
methods.description: Synchronizes this slider with another slider specified by 'asNavFor'.

methods.name: applyTransition
methods.description: Applies CSS transition styles for slide animations.

methods.name: autoPlay
methods.description: Starts automatic slide rotation based on 'autoplaySpeed'.

methods.name: autoPlayClear
methods.description: Stops the autoplay timer.

methods.name: autoPlayIterator
methods.description: Advances the slide during autoplay.

methods.name: buildArrows
methods.description: Creates and configures navigation arrow elements.

methods.name: buildDots
methods.description: Creates and configures pagination dots.

methods.name: buildOut
methods.description: Initializes the slider DOM structure and prepares slides.

methods.name: buildRows
methods.description: Arranges slides into multiple rows if 'rows' option > 1.

methods.name: checkResponsive
methods.description: Handles responsive behavior based on window size and breakpoints.

methods.name: changeSlide
methods.description: Handles slide change commands (next, previous, specific index).

methods.name: checkNavigable
methods.description: Ensures the target slide index is valid and navigable.

methods.name: cleanUpEvents
methods.description: Removes event listeners attached to the slider.

methods.name: cleanUpSlideEvents
methods.description: Removes slide-specific event listeners.

methods.name: cleanUpRows
methods.description: Restores original slide structure if rows are used.

methods.name: clickHandler
methods.description: Handles click events on slides or navigation elements.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the slider instance, removing DOM modifications and event listeners.

methods.name: disableTransition
methods.description: Disables CSS transitions for a slide.

methods.name: fadeSlide
methods.description: Performs a fade-in transition for a slide.

methods.name: fadeSlideOut
methods.description: Performs a fade-out transition for a slide.

methods.name: filterSlides
methods.description: Filters slides based on a selector or function.

methods.name: focusHandler
methods.description: Handles focus events for accessibility and autoplay control.

methods.name: getCurrent
methods.description: Returns the current slide index.

methods.name: getDotCount
methods.description: Calculates the number of pagination dots needed.

methods.name: getLeft
methods.description: Calculates the left position for a given slide index.

methods.name: goTo
methods.description: Navigates to a specific slide index.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the slider, sets up DOM, events, and responsiveness.

methods.name: initADA
methods.description: Initializes accessibility attributes for ARIA compliance.

methods.name: initArrowEvents
methods.description: Sets up event handlers for navigation arrows.

methods.name: initDotEvents
methods.description: Sets up event handlers for pagination dots.

methods.name: initSlideEvents
methods.description: Sets up event handlers for slide interactions.

methods.name: initializeEvents
methods.description: Initializes all event handlers for the slider.

methods.name: initUI
methods.description: Displays navigation arrows and dots if applicable.

methods.name: keyHandler
methods.description: Handles keyboard navigation for accessibility.

methods.name: lazyLoad
methods.description: Loads lazy images within the slider based on current position.

methods.name: loadSlider
methods.description: Finalizes slider setup and triggers initial layout.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next slide.

methods.name: orientationChange
methods.description: Handles orientation change events, updates layout.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses autoplay.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Resumes autoplay.

methods.name: postSlide
methods.description: Actions after a slide transition, including event triggers and focus.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Goes to the previous slide.

methods.name: preventDefault
methods.description: Prevents default event behavior.

methods.name: progressiveLazyLoad
methods.description: Loads images progressively with retries.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Reinitializes the slider, useful after DOM changes.

methods.name: registerBreakpoints
methods.description: Sets up responsive breakpoints based on configuration.

methods.name: reinit
methods.description: Reinitializes the slider after DOM or options change.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Handles window resize events, updates layout.

methods.name: removeSlide
methods.description: Removes a slide at a specified index.

methods.name: setCSS
methods.description: Applies CSS transforms for slide positioning.

methods.name: setDimensions
methods.description: Calculates and sets slide and track dimensions.

methods.name: setFade
methods.description: Sets up fade transition styles for slides.

methods.name: setHeight
methods.description: Adjusts slider height based on current slide.

methods.name: setOption
methods.description: Updates slider options dynamically.
